rows.title: Proposal : Adds gitpod support for the repository for better DX
rows.excerpt: Hey there, Not affiliated to the product in any way, I just love the product. I created #952 that adds support for gitpod in the repository. When merging the PR, clicking on the open with gitpod button in the README would clone the repository in an online vscode (or IntelliJ) editor, but also run the application directly without the user having to do anything. This is what it looks like for me right after clicking the link : Given that the petclinic is used a lot for proof of concepts, as a demo and for workshops, I believe that adding that capability greatly increases the developer experience because it allows folks to get running within seconds without even having to setup java. _Note that that the button as it stands in the README will not work as expected before the PR is merged_. To test the feature, please use this link instead : https://gitpod.io/github.com/jlengrand/spring-petclinic/tree/feature/add-gitpod This is a gentle proposal, feel free to refuse of course!

## Why

This fork is the application component of a three-repository delivery model. Contributors need a clear ownership boundary so application code, reusable automation, and environment promotion state remain separated.

## Verification

- Preserved the upstream README and existing project structure.
- Confirmed the change contains only the boundary document and additive ignore rules.
